cohort: 870 pregnant women with well-monitored GDM compared to 1,553,420 pregnancies in the general Swedish population
finding: Despite higher initial maternal body weight, women with GDM gained less weight during pregnancy and had similar birthweights to the general population, potentially due to good metabolic control and shorter gestational length.
mod_finding: The percentage of cesarean deliveries was higher in the GDM group compared to the general population (18.4% vs 13.3%).
birth_weight: 3564 ± 500 g in the GDM group and 3580 ± 483 g in the general population
